title: Suilend · Snapshot diagnostics
description: Immutable census, cached economic exposure and illustrative stress scenarios.

options.content:
### Cached valuations · economic score unavailable
A saved snapshot, **not live monitoring**. Cached prices may come from different times. Colors describe cached health-factor ranges; they do not prove liquidation eligibility.

Stress scenarios are **illustrative sensitivities** with assumed recovery discounts. Fresh valuations and recovery validation are required before an economic score can be published. Market discovery includes experimental and third-party instances.

panels.title: Readiness · all checks
panels.description: 0 means freshness, coverage, scope or monitor health failed; inspect readiness reason.

panels.title: Monitor workers + database
panels.description: No data means no monitor heartbeat was received; do not interpret missing data as healthy.

panels.title: Observation freshness · deployed policy
panels.description: Thresholds come from the running policy, independently of cached financial valuation.

panels.title: Pending notifications
panels.description: Durable deliveries awaiting success. Inspect with admin --scope SCOPE inspect.

panels.title: Scheduler heartbeat age
panels.description: A missing/stale heartbeat means unattended capture supervision is not demonstrated.

panels.title: Free capture storage
panels.description: Captures stop below the policy disk floor. Pinned incident evidence is never auto-deleted.

panels.title: Last capture duration
panels.description: Full capture and validation elapsed time, not HTTP serving latency.

panels.title: Consecutive capture failures
panels.description: Inspect run journals and provider/disk status; last good reports remain readable.

panels.title: Observer heartbeat age
panels.description: Observation and incident processing are independent of capture scheduling.

panels.title: Delivery heartbeat age
panels.description: Inspect database/receiver connectivity when delivery stops.

panels.title: Dead letters · operator action
panels.description: Inspect then use audited admin retry with a reason; receiver must deduplicate Idempotency-Key.

panels.title: Oldest queued delivery
panels.description: No sample when queue is empty or unavailable; compare pending count and monitor health.

panels.title: Last reload attempt age
panels.description: A stale poller can retain an old report; observation freshness still expires.

panels.title: Last reload failed
panels.description: Last good generation remains available. Check /status for the reload error.

panels.title: Unapplied run outcomes
panels.description: Durable lifecycle records waiting for incident processing.

panels.title: GraphQL retries · latest capture
panels.description: Measured attempts, not inferred page counts. Partial runs may have a last-observed counter.

panels.title: OBSERVATION AGE · not valuation age
panels.description: Compare the policy-driven freshness status above. Cached financial valuation age is unknown.

panels.title: Coverage · completeness is separate from valuation confidence
Economic exposure · cached obligation values, not protocol TVL
Economic score · worst selected market
panels.description: 0–100, higher is worse. Unavailable unless every selected market is scored. Worst market is not a pooled protocol score.

targets.expr: (max((sui_sentinel_economic_score{job="sui-sentinel",market=~"$market"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="sui-sentinel"} == 1))) and on() (min((sui_sentinel_economic_score_available{job="sui-sentinel",market=~"$market"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="sui-sentinel"} == 1))) == 1)) or (min((sui_sentinel_economic_score_available{job="sui-sentinel",market=~"$market"} and on(job,instance) (up{job="sui-sentinel"} == 1))) * 0 - 1)

panels.title: Debt with cached HF < 1
panels.description: Not current liquidatable debt or expected loss.
